jobs.description:
Assent Advisory Group

Full Time

Quantico, VA

Posted 1 day ago

Ions

Quantico, Virginia

Job Description

Assent Advisory Group is seeking a Data Analyst to support our client in Quantico, Virginia. This position will support program management, data analytics, IMS maintenance, Monthly Status Reports, planning data, environmental planning support, engineering support, acquisition support, and facilities operations reporting.

This task requires continuous weekly IMS maintenance, 12 Monthly Status Reports annually, planning support, environmental planning documentation, multi-discipline engineering review support, acquisition support packages, and facilities operations and maintenance support.

Role And Responsibilities

Maintain the local Integrated Master Schedule on a continuous weekly basis.
Draft Monthly Status Reports for Quantico operations.
Support program visibility, project tracking, schedule tracking, and leadership reporting.
Collect, analyze, and report facilities, planning, environmental, engineering, and acquisition support data.
Support development of preliminary master plans, layout studies, and BFR validation tracking.
Track engineering design review activity and project submission status.
Support acquisition support tracking, including SOW/PWS/IGCE request status and historical cost data.
Track service contract compliance evaluations, warranty data, and preventive maintenance work plan status.
Support dashboards, trackers, issue logs, briefing materials, and ad hoc data calls.
Coordinate with planners, engineers, environmental staff, acquisition support personnel, CORs, and Government leadership.

Experience

3–10 years of experience in data analysis, program support, project tracking, schedule management, facilities analytics, or Government consulting.
Experience maintaining trackers, schedules, dashboards, status reports, and recurring deliverables.
Experience supporting facilities, engineering, acquisition, environmental, or public works programs preferred.
Experience with Microsoft Project, Excel, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar tools.
Strong written communication, reporting, stakeholder coordination, and analytical skills.
Experience supporting federal government or Department of Defense programs preferred.
Experience supporting program management, IMS maintenance, project tracking, Monthly Status Reports, dashboards, and facilities/infrastructure program data analysis.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Construction Management, Facilities Management, Public Administration, or a related field preferred, but not specifically required by the PWS.

Qualifications

U.S. Citizen.
Ability to obtain and maintain CAC access.
Current PMP certification (preferred)

Preferred Technical Skills

IMS management.
Facilities planning, BFR tracking, NEPA documentation tracking, SOW/PWS/IGCE support, service contract compliance tracking.
MILCON, FSRM, UMMC, demolition, facilities operations, or installation support.

Job Features

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Assent Advisory Group

Full Time

Arlington, VA

Posted 1 day ago

Locations:

Arlington, Virginia

Job Description

Assent Advisory Group is seeking a Data Analyst Journeyman — Enterprise Integration GIS & Data to support enterprise facilities program management, data integration, GIS reconciliation, financial analysis, and executive reporting activities. This position will support the Facilities Directorate by helping maintain enterprise visibility across global infrastructure portfolios, including MILCON, UMMC, FSRM, demolition, real property, and capital investment efforts.

The Data Analyst will support enterprise-level analysis by reconciling geospatial, financial, and property data; maintaining data integrity across authoritative systems; and developing reporting products that help Government leadership track project execution, investment strategies, and facility portfolio performance. Task 4.1 specifically includes enterprise support for IMS management, asset management planning, GIS/iNFADS reconciliation, financial analysis, capital investment support, engineering portfolio support, and public works analysis.

Role And Responsibilities

Support enterprise data integration and analysis across facilities portfolios.
Maintain and support the enterprise GIS / GEOFidelis data model.
Perform GIS and iNFADS data reconciliation to identify discrepancies, validate facility footprints, and align spatial data with official property records.
Integrate financial and property data into geospatial layers, cartographic products, and automated executive dashboards.
Develop financial metrics, analyze spending plans, draft financial summaries, and support long-term investment analysis for senior leadership review.
Support enterprise-level tracking and analysis of MILCON, UMMC, FSRM, and demolition project execution.
Extract, analyze, and summarize project, financial, and execution data for leadership reporting.
Support automated reporting solutions and dashboards for financial and execution data.
Assist with weekly fiscal updates, execution metric reports, and variance analysis.
Support data validation, quality control, and deliverable preparation.
Coordinate with planners, public works personnel, regional stakeholders, and Government leadership as needed.

Experience

3–10 years of relevant experience in data analysis, GIS data management, business intelligence, financial analysis, real property data, facilities analytics, or program support.
Experience working with structured datasets and reconciling information across multiple authoritative sources.
Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, reports, or executive-level analytical products.
Experience with GIS, geospatial data, property records, asset management data, or facilities infrastructure data.
Experience supporting federal, DoD, USMC, Navy, NAVFAC, facilities, real property, or infrastructure programs preferred.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong Excel, data analysis, documentation, and quality control skills.
Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Planning, or a related field preferred, but not required

Licenses/Certifications

Relevant certifications are preferred but not required, including:

Geographic Information Systems Professional GISP® certification
At least five years of demonstrated experience working directly with SDSFIE — Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment.

Preferred Technical Skills

GEOFidelis, iNFADS, SDSFIE, GIS data models, or spatial data standards.
Power BI or other dashboard/reporting tools.
Microsoft Project, Excel, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Microsoft 365.
Facilities portfolio analysis, MILCON, FSRM, UMMC, demolition tracking, or real property management.
Financial execution analysis, budget tracking, variance analysis, or investment planning support.

Job Features

Job Category Data Scientist

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Assent Advisory Group

Full Time

Arlington, VA

Posted 1 day ago

Locations:

Arlington, Virginia

Job Description

Assent Advisory Group is seeking a Data Analyst Journeyman — Enterprise Integration GIS & Data to support enterprise facilities program management, data integration, GIS reconciliation, financial analysis, and executive reporting activities. This position will support the Facilities Directorate by helping maintain enterprise visibility across global infrastructure portfolios, including MILCON, UMMC, FSRM, demolition, real property, and capital investment efforts.

The Data Analyst will support enterprise-level analysis by reconciling geospatial, financial, and property data; maintaining data integrity across authoritative systems; and developing reporting products that help Government leadership track project execution, investment strategies, and facility portfolio performance. Task 4.1 specifically includes enterprise support for IMS management, asset management planning, GIS/iNFADS reconciliation, financial analysis, capital investment support, engineering portfolio support, and public works analysis.

Role And Responsibilities

Support enterprise data integration and analysis across facilities portfolios.
Maintain and support the enterprise GIS / GEOFidelis data model.
Perform GIS and iNFADS data reconciliation to identify discrepancies, validate facility footprints, and align spatial data with official property records.
Integrate financial and property data into geospatial layers, cartographic products, and automated executive dashboards.
Develop financial metrics, analyze spending plans, draft financial summaries, and support long-term investment analysis for senior leadership review.
Support enterprise-level tracking and analysis of MILCON, UMMC, FSRM, and demolition project execution.
Extract, analyze, and summarize project, financial, and execution data for leadership reporting.
Support automated reporting solutions and dashboards for financial and execution data.
Assist with weekly fiscal updates, execution metric reports, and variance analysis.
Support data validation, quality control, and deliverable preparation.
Coordinate with planners, public works personnel, regional stakeholders, and Government leadership as needed.

Experience

3–10 years of relevant experience in data analysis, GIS data management, business intelligence, financial analysis, real property data, facilities analytics, or program support.
Experience working with structured datasets and reconciling information across multiple authoritative sources.
Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, reports, or executive-level analytical products.
Experience with GIS, geospatial data, property records, asset management data, or facilities infrastructure data.
Experience supporting federal, DoD, USMC, Navy, NAVFAC, facilities, real property, or infrastructure programs preferred.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong Excel, data analysis, documentation, and quality control skills.
Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Planning, or a related field preferred, but not required

Licenses/Certifications

Relevant certifications are preferred but not required, including:

Geographic Information Systems Professional GISP® certification
At least five years of demonstrated experience working directly with SDSFIE — Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment.

Preferred Technical Skills

GEOFidelis, iNFADS, SDSFIE, GIS data models, or spatial data standards.
Power BI or other dashboard/reporting tools.
Microsoft Project, Excel, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Microsoft 365.
Facilities portfolio analysis, MILCON, FSRM, UMMC, demolition tracking, or real property management.
Financial execution analysis, budget tracking, variance analysis, or investment planning support.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

The Junior Project Coordinator works to support Project Managers throughout the product delivery lifecycle. The Junior Project Coordinator provides a wide range of general services that support the functional requirements of a product or customer activity. These areas may include data reporting, backlog support in JIRA, data quality analysis, administration or management support, documentation support for product artifacts including roadmaps and summary of JIRA sprint cycles.

This position is fully remote within the United States.

Responsibilities

Support the functional requirements of a project or product activity. These areas may include project initiation, resource scheduling, status reporting, data quality analysis, quality assurance, system or business operations, administration or management support.
Perform significant work responsibilities with minimal management oversight.
Strong communication, writing, and editing skills.
Strong organization skills to manage multiple timelines and complete tasks quickly within the constraints of clients’ timelines and budgets.
Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Office Applications: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Atlassian Tool Suite and Mural
Strong self-management skills
Must submit to and be able to successfully complete customer required clearance, investigative or training requirements.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

Bachelor's with 5 - 8 years (or commensurate experience)
Effective Verbal and Written Communications Skills
Attention to detail.
Ability to prioritize requirements and meet deadlines.
Ability to learn in a fast-paced environment.
Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.

Clearance Required:
Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience with JIRA and the Atlassian Tool Suite

Posted Salary Range: USD $75,000.00 - USD $85,000.00 /Yr.
